skills.name: Slash
skills.description: A swift, disciplined blade slash dealing clean physical damage.

skills.name: Precision Thrust
skills.description: A pinpoint lunging thrust targeting weak points in enemy armor.

skills.name: Heavy Cleave
skills.description: A crushing, two-handed overhead chop delivering devastating impact.

skills.name: Pommel Strike
skills.description: A sharp strike using the heavy pommel, dazing and stunning the foe.

skills.name: Quick Flurry
skills.description: A rapid succession of lacerating cuts that inflicts bleeding.

skills.name: Crush
skills.description: A brutal blunt impact that fractures bone and shatters heavy armor.

skills.name: Sweeping Strike
skills.description: A wide horizontal swing cleaving through the enemy ranks.

skills.name: Parry & Riposte
skills.description: Deflects incoming melee strikes and instantly delivers a lethal counter-thrust.

skills.name: Shield Bash
skills.description: Slams a reinforced shield into the target's face, staggering their stance.

skills.name: Orcish Skull-Crusher
skills.description: Channels savage Orcish rage into a ground-shaking warhammer strike that crushes armor and stuns.

skills.name: Savage Rend
skills.description: Rips open deep wounds, inflicting lingering bleeding damage over time.
